tour.welcomeContent: Let's take a quick tour to help you get started with your new focused email experience.
tour.triageContent: This is where new emails land. Quickly decide to reply, archive, or snooze them.
tour.processContent: Star an email to move it here. This is your focused workspace for emails that need action.
tour.deliveryContent: New emails are batched and delivered every few hours to prevent distractions. Use 'Deliver Now' if you need to check urgently.

scan.title: Personalize Your Experience
scan.content: To help BearlyMail learn your priorities and writing style, we can scan your recent email history. This data stays private and is only used to train your personal model.
scan.permission: Allow scanning of last 7 days of emails
